svg.title: The discovery cycle being built
svg.desc: Detailed workflow with protocol, computation, domain checks, verdict, custody and replay, retained evidence and domain-owned model updates. Human authority and discovery/domain ownership are shown. Current protocol and harness development is in progress; scientific execution follows the separately authorised freeze.

g.text: Protocols, domain execution, replay and model ownership · work in progress · 13 October 2026
Protocol freeze + specified computation scope + outward release / publication
Human approval of the frozen scope
Report where the result is valid
Use the record to form the next question
Retained attempt records enter the evidence and verdict path
Next question comes from the retained outcome, including a negative result
Owns the loop and the common yardstick.
Can refuse a record for custody or replay failure.
Does not change the domain’s scientific verdict.
Owns models, physics, oracles and calibration.
Executes or declines the experiment request.
Accepts its own model revisions and validity claims.
Sets rules, budget and assigned authority.
Approves freeze and named computation scope.
A protocol approval is not a physical-action grant.
EVIDENCE PACKAGE — WHAT THE NEXT SESSION OR REPLICATOR RECEIVES
Protocol digest · input and attempt identifiers · seeds and budgets · domain validity criteria
Raw retained output · simulator / instrument status · calibration and version context · scientific verdict
Deterministic derivation · content hashes · replay result · custody and reviewer attribution
Outcome and model-update lineage · failure history · cost and energy fields as measurement is integrated
Current frame: v0.15, review and harness work.
Held-out simulated systems; retained failure outcomes.
In progress: protocol, adapter and replay-harness work.
Current source frame: v0.5, review and preparation.
AdEx surrogate with a scoped validity boundary.
Preregistered protocol, independent checks and replay.
Domain choices remain with the neuromorphic group.
Sources: discovery group boundaries, current protocol frames and the research investment plan; source digests embedded in the SVG metadata.
Technical interfaces, record formats and the full cycle are in progress. Scientific execution follows the authorised freeze.
